successCriteria.description: `EmployeeRepository` class implements `IEmployeeRepository` and queries the `employees` table via the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`. `findById` returns `Employee | null`, `findByEmail` returns `Employee | null`, `findByDepartment` returns `Employee[]`.

`EmployeeService` class implements `IEmployeeService`, accepts `IEmployeeRepository` in its constructor, and delegates `getEmployeeById` → `repository.findById` and `getEmployeeByEmail` → `repository.findByEmail`.

`AuditService` class implements `IAuditService`, accepts the shared `pool` in its constructor. The `record` method generates a UUID `id` and sets `createdAt` to `new Date()`, inserts into the `audit_records` table, and returns the created `AuditRecord`.

Barrel `src/modules/employee/index.ts` re-exports `Employee`, `IEmployeeRepository`, `EmployeeRepository`, `IEmployeeService`, `EmployeeService`. Barrel `src/modules/audit/index.ts` re-exports `AuditRecord`, `IAuditService`, `AuditService`. `src/shared/types/index.ts` already exports `AuditAction` (no change needed).

Jest unit tests exist at `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.test.ts` and `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.service.test.ts`. The pg `pool` is mocked via `jest.mock`. All tests pass with `npx jest`.
All new and existing source files pass `tsc --noEmit` with strict TypeScript settings (no implicit any, strict null checks).

constraints: All database access MUST go through the repository pattern (GP-001). `EmployeeRepository` uses `pool` directly — no inline SQL in `EmployeeService`. `AuditService` is the exception per the architectural decision: it uses `pool` directly as the audit mechanism itself, with no separate repository interface.

Modules MUST import from each other ONLY via their `index.ts` barrel files (GP-001 / AGENTS.md rule 1). No deep imports like `../employee/employee.repository.interface` from outside the employee module.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards instead (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
No hardcoded secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens (HARNESS.json constraint `no-hardcoded-secrets`).

`AuditService.record` MUST generate `id` via `crypto.randomUUID()` and set `createdAt` to `new Date()` — these fields are omitted from the input per the `Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>` signature.
outOfScope: Controllers, routes, HTTP handlers, and Fastify plugin registration for employee or audit modules — deferred to later phases when the API surface is built.

entityInvariants.invariant: Employee entities are read-only in this phase. The repository only exposes finder methods (`findById`, `findByEmail`, `findByDepartment`). No create/update/delete operations exist yet.
Every `AuditRecord` is immutable once created. The `record` method is the only write path; there is no update or delete. `id` and `createdAt` are always server-generated (never caller-supplied).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth at repository layer — auth is enforced at the controller/route layer per GP-005.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` when no row matches the given `id` — never throws for a missing row.
Returns `null` when no row matches the given email — never throws for a missing row.
Returns an empty array `[]` when no employees match the department — never returns `null`.
Each call creates a new `AuditRecord` with a fresh UUID. Fails with a database error if the insert violates constraints (e.g., missing required fields). Never silently drops the record.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `EmployeeRepository` MUST import and use the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no separate pool or connection.
`AuditService` MUST import and use the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no separate pool or connection.

`EmployeeService` MUST implement `IEmployeeService` as defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.service.interface.ts` — matching the exact method signatures (`getEmployeeById`, `getEmployeeByEmail`) and return types.

`EmployeeRepository` MUST implement `IEmployeeRepository` as defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.repository.interface.ts` — matching the exact method signatures (`findById`, `findByEmail`, `findByDepartment`) and return types.

The `employees` table queried by `EmployeeRepository` MUST have columns matching the `Employee` interface: `id`, `full_name` (maps to `fullName`), `email`, `department`, `manager_id` (maps to `managerId`), `created_at` (maps to `createdAt`), `updated_at` (maps to `updatedAt`). Snake_case column names in SQL map to camelCase in the TypeScript interface.

The `audit_records` table queried by `AuditService` MUST have columns matching the `AuditRecord` interface: `id`, `entity_type` (maps to `entityType`), `entity_id` (maps to `entityId`), `action`, `performed_by` (maps to `performedBy`), `changes`, `created_at` (maps to `createdAt`). Snake_case column names in SQL map to camelCase in the TypeScript interface.

integrationPoints.why: Both `EmployeeRepository` and `AuditService` import the shared `pool` for all PostgreSQL queries. This is the single database connection point for the entire application.
